description: Import a Motion Graphics Template (.mogrt) file and add it to the timeline. Pass text_values (for example { "Headline": "..." }) to write each text control explicitly after insertion and verify it by readback, so a template default or stale value is never left in place silently.

text_values.description: Optional map of MOGRT text parameter display names to the exact text to write (for example { "Headline": "Chapter 3" }). Each value is written explicitly after import and read back; the result reports verified, mismatch, missing_property, or committed_unverified per field.

name: import_mogrt

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Import Mogrt
